case_title.quote: SUMITHA PRADEEP v. ARUN KUMAR C.K & ANR.

accused_gender.quote: he sexually assaulted his 12 years old niece

accused_age.reason: No age of the accused appears in the judgment.

accused_occupation.quote: the petitioner being an advocate has high influence
accused_occupation.reason: Sessions court order, quoted, notes accused is an advocate.

accused_socioeconomic_status.reason: No socioeconomic status stated, only influence claim.

accused_victim_relationship.quote: her maternal uncle, namely, Respondent No.1
accused_victim_relationship.reason: Relative (maternal uncle); consistent, though could be more specific.

offence_category.quote: sexually assaulted his 12 years old niece

statutory_provisions.quote: Sections 354A(1)(i),(ii) & (iv), 354 A-(2) and 354-A(3) of the Indian Penal Code read with Sections 7, 8, 9 and 11

evidence_type.correct_value: Medical examination, victim's s.164 statement, counsellor's statement, case diary, educational report
evidence_type.quote: medical examination was conducted and Statement of the victim under Section 164
evidence_type.reason: Broadly right but omits educational report and case diary; counselling records inferred.

aggravating_circumstances.quote: the victim was traumatized to such a high degree that her academic pursuits were adversely impacted

mitigating_circumstances.reason: No mitigating circumstances noted by the court.

final_outcome.correct_value: Appeal allowed; High Court's anticipatory bail order set aside
final_outcome.quote: we allow this appeal; set aside the impugned Judgment and Order
final_outcome.reason: No trial or acquittal; only bail order was set aside.

offence_finally_established.quote: without expressing any views on merits of the case
offence_finally_established.reason: No offence established at this stage.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Omits that the accused is maternal uncle only by 'niece'; 'immediately registered' FIR and charge-sheet; otherwise accurate and outcome-neutral
neutral_facts.quote: the subject First Information Report was immediately registered
neutral_facts.reason: Accurate and neutral, but omits the bail-proceedings context.

offence_severity.reason: Judgment gives no punishment range for the offences.

attempt_completion.correct_value: Mixed: alleged completed acts (hugging, kissing, touching) and attempts (to kiss lips, disrobe)
attempt_completion.quote: tried to kiss her on her lips. He further attempted to disrobe
attempt_completion.reason: Some acts alleged as completed, others attempted.

physical_harm.correct_value: No physical injury stated; psychological trauma affecting studies
physical_harm.quote: incident traumatized her to an extent that she slumped down in her course
physical_harm.reason: Describes psychological, not physical, harm; labelling is loose.

number_of_offences.reason: One FIR with multiple sections; counts not stated.

motive.correct_value: Not identified by the court; accused alleged false case due to property dispute
motive.quote: retaliatory step taken by the mother of the victim in view of the property disputes
motive.reason: Defence alleged retaliation; no motive for the offence stated.

key_evidence_accepted.correct_value: Court relied on FIR allegations supported by victim's s.164 statement and her trauma/academic decline
key_evidence_accepted.quote: specific allegations contained in the FIR, duly supported with the Statement of the victim
key_evidence_accepted.reason: Largely right, but Section 29 was expressly not decided.

witness_credibility.correct_value: Court noted allegations supported by s.164 statement; credibility not formally assessed; delay explained by Sessions Court
witness_credibility.quote: without expressing any views on merits of the case
witness_credibility.reason: Overstates a credibility assessment by the Supreme Court.

post_offence_conduct.reason: No post-offence conduct of accused stated.

bail_history.correct_value: Sessions Court declined; High Court granted conditional anticipatory bail; Supreme Court set aside the order
bail_history.quote: set aside the impugned Judgment and Order dated 25-7-2022
bail_history.reason: Omits Sessions refusal; 'quashed' is loosely used.

legal_representation.quote: Gaurav Agrawal, Ms. Anu K. Joy, Alim Anvar, Arvind Gupta, Advs. for the Appellant

procedural_irregularity.correct_value: Court found High Court's para 9 observations unwarranted and that it ignored a binding precedent (Joy)
procedural_irregularity.quote: He could not have ignored a binding decision.
procedural_irregularity.reason: Court criticised High Court's approach, so 'None noted' is off.

appeal_history.correct_value: Sessions Court declined; High Court granted; Supreme Court allowed victim's mother's appeal and set aside order
appeal_history.quote: we allow this appeal; set aside the impugned Judgment
appeal_history.reason: Substantively right; 'quashed' wording loose and appellant omitted.

prosecution_argument.correct_value: Allegations of assault, trauma, delay explained by counselling; victim's counsel argued bail would harm victim and accused may interfere
prosecution_argument.quote: granting of bail would adversely affect her mental condition
prosecution_argument.reason: Mostly allegations; 'investigation ongoing' conflicts with charge-sheet filed.

defence_argument.correct_value: Accused argued delay, retaliatory case over property disputes, no custodial interrogation needed, charge-sheet filed
defence_argument.reason: Value attributes the appellant's argument (free hand to IO) to the defence.

legal_principle_applied.correct_value: Prima facie case, nature of offence and severity come first; custodial interrogation not the sole ground; Section 29 expressly not decided
legal_principle_applied.quote: We are not going into the issue of Section 29 of the POCSO Act
legal_principle_applied.reason: Misstates Section 29 as the applied principle.

precedent_relied_upon.quote: Joy v. State of Kerala (2019) 1 KLT 935

judicial_aggravating_factors.correct_value: Serious allegations; victim traumatised with academic impact; POCSO legislative intent
judicial_aggravating_factors.quote: the victim – girl is traumatized to such a high degree
judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: Court did weigh these factors, so 'None' is wrong.

other_sentence_order.correct_value: Investigating Officer granted liberty to proceed in accordance with law
other_sentence_order.quote: Investigating Officer is granted liberty to proceed further in accordance with law.
other_sentence_order.reason: No sentence, but the court issued this direction.
